## MGIT Civil Engineering Students Win Second Prize in CIVIQ Quiz at INFRANOVA’26, Vasavi College of Engineering

News Date : 15 Oct 2026News ReportHyderabad, 15 October 2026The Department of Civil Engineering, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), is pleased to announce that its students won the Second Prize in CIVIQ – Civil Quiz at INFRANOVA’26.INFRANOVA’26 was a technical symposium organised by the Department of Civil Engineering, Vasavi College of Engineering (Autonomous), Hyderabad, under the aegis of the Institution of Engineers (India) (IEI) Students’ Chapter, on 13 October 2026.The winning team, from V Semester B.Tech Civil Engineering, included:– Karthikeya– Aravind– VishnuvardhanCIVIQ tested participants on core civil engineering concepts, technical aptitude and general awareness of the civil engineering field. The MGIT team’s performance reflected a strong grasp of fundamentals and quick thinking under competitive conditions.The Department congratulates the students on their achievement and appreciates their enthusiasm, technical knowledge and competitive spirit. The management, Principal, Head of the Department, faculty and staff of MGIT wish them continued success in their academic and professional pursuits.

Hyderabad, 15 October 2026
The Department of Civil Engineering, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), is pleased to announce that its students won the Second Prize in CIVIQ – Civil Quiz at INFRANOVA’26.
INFRANOVA’26 was a technical symposium organised by the Department of Civil Engineering, Vasavi College of Engineering (Autonomous), Hyderabad, under the aegis of the Institution of Engineers (India) (IEI) Students’ Chapter, on 13 October 2026.
The winning team, from V Semester B.Tech Civil Engineering, included:– Karthikeya– Aravind– Vishnuvardhan
CIVIQ tested participants on core civil engineering concepts, technical aptitude and general awareness of the civil engineering field. The MGIT team’s performance reflected a strong grasp of fundamentals and quick thinking under competitive conditions.
The Department congratulates the students on their achievement and appreciates their enthusiasm, technical knowledge and competitive spirit. The management, Principal, Head of the Department, faculty and staff of MGIT wish them continued success in their academic and professional pursuits.
